wikistories-extensiondesc: Wikistories waxay u oggolaanaysaa tifaftirayaasha inay ka abuuraan mashaariicda Wikimedia aqoon gaaban, muuqaal leh oo la isku hallayn karo
namespaceinfo-description-ns1705: Meel magaca ee doodaha Sheekooyinka Wikiga
deletepage-deletestory: Ka saar Sheekooyinka Wikiga ku xiran maqaalkan
wikistories-beta-feature-description:
Qalab kuu oggolaanaya inaad doorato sawirro oo aad calaamadiso xaqiiqooyin ka socda maqaal si aad uga abuurto Wikipedia aqoon gaaban, muuqaal leh oo la isku hallayn karo oo si degdeg ah loo isticmaali karo. Daar si aad u samayso waxyaabahan:
- Soo hel sheekooyin ku lifaaqan maqaal.
- Guji/taabo astaanta [+] ee ka hooseysa cinwaanka maqaalka si aad u abuurto sheeko cusub.
wikistories-pref-showdiscovery-help-mess: Sheekooyinka Wikiga waa muuqaal cusub oo kuu oggolaanaya inaad abuurto nuxur gaaban oo u eg sheeko, adigoo isticmaalaya qoraallo iyo sawirro laga soo qaatay maqaallada Wikipedia.
wikistories-recentchangesflags-legend: Tani waa wax ka beddel lagu sameeyay Sheeko Wiki ah oo ku xiran maqaal
wikistories-rcfilters-hidewikistories-de: Wax ka beddellada Sheekooyinka Wiki-ga ee ku jira bogagga maqaallada
rcshowhidewikistories: $1 wax ka beddel oo lagu sameeyay Sheekooyinka Wiki-ga ee maqaallada
wikistories-specialstorybuilder-nojswarn: Boggan gaarka ah wuxuu u baahan yahay JavaScript si uu u shaqeeyo
wikistories-specialstorybuilder-mustbelo: Fadlan soo gal akoonkaaga ama samee akoon si aad u abuurto sheekooyin
wikistories-specialstorybuilder-invalids: URL-ka ku sheeg maqaal aad rabto in laga sameeyo sheeko ama cinwaanka sheeko aad rabto in wax laga beddelo. Waa inaad sidoo kale ku dartaa meel magaca sheekada.
wikistories-story-edittext-duplicate: Qoraal nuqul ah ayaa la helay, ma beddelnaa?
wikistories-story-edittext-initial: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad ilaalisay saxnaanta sheekooyinka
wikistories-story-edittext-medium: Markaad wax ka beddelayso, fadlan ilaali macnaha asalka ah ee qoraalka
wikistories-story-edittext-last: Fadlan iska ilaali inaad ka saarto qoraal aad u badan
wikistories-article-info-banner-sentence: Taabo si aad u doorato/uga saarto doorashada jumlad.
wikistories-confirmdialog-delete-message: Waxaa si joogto ah looga saari doonaa sheekadaada.
wikistories-confirmdialog-discardstory-m: Waxaad lumin doontaa bogag kasta, sawirro iyo ku-darista qoraal ee aad samaysay.
wikistories-confirmdialog-discardedits-t: Ma iska tuurtaa wax ka beddellada?
wikistories-confirmdialog-discardedits-m: Waxaad lumin doontaa bogag kasta, sawirro iyo wax ka beddellada qoraalka ee aad samaysay.
wikistories-toast-maxframes-addingmore: Sheeko kasta waxay yeelan kartaa ugu badnaan {{PLURAL:$1|$1 bog|$1 bogag}}. Si aad bog cusub ugu darto, fadlan tirtir mid jira.
wikistories-toast-maxframes-selecting: Ugu badnaan {{PLURAL:$1|$1 sawir ayaa|$1 sawirro ayaa}} loo oggol yahay sheeko kasta.
wikistories-notice-user-block: Akoonkaaga hadda waxaa laga xannibay wax ka beddelka ama abuurista Sheeko Wiki.
wikistories-error-notenoughframes-messag: Dhammaan Sheekooyinka Wiki-ga waxay u baahan yihiin ugu yaraan {{PLURAL:$1|1=hal|2=laba|3=shan|4=afar|5=shan|10=toban|$1}} {{PLURAL:$1|bog|bogag}}. Fadlan ku dar {{PLURAL:$2|1=hal|2=laba|3=saddex|4=afar|5=shan|10=toban|$2}} {{PLURAL:$2|bog dheeraad ah|bogag dheeraad ah}}.
wikistories-error-frameswithouttext-mess: Dhammaan bogagga Sheekada Wiki-ga waxay u baahan yihiin qoraal. Fadlan ku dar qoraal {{PLURAL:$1|$1 bogga sheekada|$1 bogagga sheekada}}.
wikistories-builder-article-not-availabl: Qoraalka maqaalka lama heli karo. Fadlan mar kale isku day goor dambe
wikistories-builder-publishform-summary-: Qor soo koobidda wax ka beddelka
Sharax wax ka beddellada (tusaale, 'Beddelay sawir', 'Saxay xaqiiqooyin')
wikistories-builder-publishform-info: Sheekooyinka la daabacay waxaa laga heli doonaa bogga maqaalka.
wikistories-builder-publishform-invalidt: Sheeko leh cinwaankan hore ayay u jirtaa. Fadlan geli cinwaan cusub.
wikistories-builder-publishform-saveerro: Khalad ayaa dhacay markii la daabacayay Sheekada Wiki-ga. Fadlan isku day inaad mar kale daabacdo.
wikistories-builder-publishform-saving-d: Hambalyo! Sheekada Wiki-ga waa la daabacay
wikistories-builder-licensing-with-terms: Markaad sii waddo, waxaad oggolaanaysaa [$1 Shuruudaha Isticmaalka], waxaadna si aan laga noqon karin u oggolaanaysaa in wax ku biirintaada lagu sii daayo shatiyada [$2 CC BY-SA 3.0] iyo [$3 GFDL].
wikistories-nojs-form-categories-label: Magacyada qaybaha, iyada oo aan lagu darin meel magaca, midkiiba hal sadar
wikistories-nojs-viewer-error: $1 {{PLURAL:$1|sawir|sawirro}} loo adeegsaday sheekadan {{PLURAL:$1|ma}} aha mid laga heli karo Commons.
wikistories-nojs-viewer-no-article: Muhiim! Maqaalka ku xiran sheekadan hadda lama heli karo. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad u baahato inaad tirtirto sheekada si loo ilaaliyo saxnaanta.
wikistories-discover-cta-text-subheader: Noqo qofka ugu horreeya ee sawir ku muujinaya xaqiiqooyinka muhiimka ah ee mawduucan si ay uga faa'iidaystaan dadka wax ku barta muuqaal ahaan.
wikistories-not-enough-frames: Sheekadu ma laha muuqaallo ku filan
wikistories-too-many-frames: Sheekadu waxay leedahay muuqaallo aad u badan
wikistories-text-too-long: Qoraalka ku jira muuqaalka #$1 aad buu u dheer yahay. Wuxuu leeyahay {{PLURAL:$2|$2 xaraf|$2 xarafo}} laakiin ugu badnaan la oggol yahay waa $3.
wikistories-no-image-category-desc: Mid ka mid ah muuqaallada sheekada ma laha sawir
wikistories-no-related-article: Sheeko aan lahayn maqaal la xiriira
wikistories-no-related-article-desc: Maqaalka ku xiran Sheekada waa la tirtiray
wikistories-outdated-text-category: Sheekadu waxay leedahay qoraal duugoobay marka loo eego maqaalka isha laga soo qaatay
wikistories-outdated-text-category-desc: Qaar ka mid ah qoraalka loo adeegsaday sheekadan hadda kuma jiro maqaalka isha laga soo qaatay
ext-wikistories-storyviewaction-notfound: Sheekada Wiki-ga aad isku dayayso inaad gasho ma jirto
echo-pref-tooltip-wikistories-action: I ogeysii marka Sheeko Wiki aan la socdo ay u baahan tahay in la cusboonaysiiyo.
wikistories-notification-articlechanged-: $1 waa la tafatiray, waxaana loo baahan yahay in $2 dib loo eego
